description: Update a task. Give only the fields to change: status, title, description, priority, assignedTo (replaces the list), tags (replaces), deadline, maxHours, linkedIssue, links (replaces), parentTaskId. Archive with status "archived". The legacy `updates` JSON string is still accepted.

agentName.description: Who you are, shown in workload.zero as the creator, e.g. "Kampagnen-Agent Die Kette". Optional; without it the goal/task is still marked as agent-created.

assignedTo.description: User ids (from get_my_profile, list_users, get_my_colleagues) or team member ids (list_project_members); the API maps user ids to the project's team member

deadline.description: Start and due date of the task

linkedIssue.description: Key or URL of the issue in an external tracker, e.g. DWP-6540

links.description: Links shown on the task, e.g. the PR, the Figma frame or the prototype screen

parentTaskId.description: Mongo id of the parent task; makes this a subtask

status.description: open | in_progress | in_review | needs_rework | done | archived

taskId.description: Task Mongo id or task number such as ZERO-41

updates.description: Legacy: JSON object of fields; typed fields win

name: update_task
title: Update task
